neighbours.label: the phrase 'borne out' (a claim supported by later evidence)
fire: Their forecast was borne out by the harvest figures.
The rumor was later borne out by court records.
His warning has been borne out by events.
Her hunch was fully borne out by the blood tests.
The theory is not borne out by the fossil record.
These fears were borne out when the dam failed.
That claim was borne out by a second survey.
So far the idea has been borne out by experiment.
quiet: Their forecast was confirmed by the harvest figures.
The rumor was later supported by court records.
His warning has been proved right by events.
Her hunch was fully verified by the blood tests.
The theory is not supported by the fossil record.
These fears were justified when the dam failed.
That claim was backed up by a second survey.
So far the idea has been confirmed by experiment.
